text:
Predicates:
Appropriate(x) ::: x is appropriate for people of all ages.
Watch(x) ::: children can watch x without guidance from parents.
EroticViolent(x) ::: x contains excessive erotic and violent content.
Rated(x, y) ::: x is rated y.
FamilyFriendly(x) ::: x is a family-friendly animated film.
FrozenSeries(x) ::: x is a movie in the Frozen series.
Premises:
∀x (Appropriate(x) → Watch(x)) ::: If a film is appropriate for people of all ages, then children can watch it without guidance from parents.
∀x (EroticViolent(x) → ¬Watch(x)) ::: If a film contains excessive erotic and violent content, children cannot watch it without guidance from their parents.
∀x (Rated(x, generalAudience) → Appropriate(x)) ::: If a film is rated General Audience, then it is appropriate for people of all ages.
∀x (FamilyFriendly(x) → Rated(x, generalAudience)) ::: All family-friendly animated films are rated General Audience.
∀x (FrozenSeries(x) → FamilyFriendly(x)) ::: All movies in the Frozen series are family-friendly animated films.
Film(hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is a film.
(FamilyFriendly(hachi) ∨ Appropriate(hachi)) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is either a family-friendly animated film or is appropriate for people of all ages.
Conclusion:
EroticViolent(hachi) ∨ FrozenSeries(hachi) ∨ (EroticViolent(hachi) ∧ FrozenSeries(hachi)) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' contains excessive erotic and violent content or is in the 'Frozen' series or both.
